In this research, we analyze the power converter circuit of the photovoltaic (PV) cell emulating system and present study results of operation of this system in series connection mode under the different levels of solar irradiation.

articleTitle: Synthesis of γ-alumina nanoparticles by wire-explosion process: Characterisation and formation mechanism
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Single-step synthesis of γ-alumina (γ-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>), by wire-explosion process (WEP), is described in this work. Molecular oxygen is used as ambient gas with different levels of pressure to obtain the corresponding oxide nanoparticles (NPs). The energy (E) deposited to the capacitor, used for the explosion is in multiples of the sublimation energy. XRD and TEM techniques are used to characterise the synthesized nanoparticles. The content of γ-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> increases with increase in E and/or oxygen pressure (P). The average particle size of the nanoparticles reduces with the increase in E and/or decrease in P. The Born-Haber cycle is used to calculate the lattice energy (LE) of the bulk Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. The dependence of LE and the formation enthalpy of alumina nanoparticles with size are evaluated. A classical homogenous nucleation theory is used to see the effect of saturation ratio and temperature on the activation energy and the nucleation rate of the NPs correlating it with size dependence on E and P used in the WEP.

articleTitle: Induced voltage on medium overhead line caused by nearby strike from rocket triggered lightning
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Lightning protection experiment will be carried out by using rocket triggered lightning in Lake Jatiluhur in West Java, Indonesia. rocket pull up a copper wire located at the bottom side of the rocket and launched from the top of a platform to trigger the lightning. Copper wire connected to a measuring instrument at the launching pad. Up to a certain height, when strong electric field penetration are reached the rockets will be hit by lightning. Lightning will propagate on copper wire and through a gauge on the launching pad and lightning current parameters can be measured on equipment mounted on the platform. Lightning strikes on rockets and drain the lightning currents to the ground through copper wire will be used for measurement of induced voltage to the medium voltage distribution lines nearby. The magnitude of return stroke current will be determined and the distance to the MV lines is known and the induction voltage can be measured. This travelling wave voltage at the MV line will be protected by the new multi chamber arrester installed along the induced MV line.

articleTitle: Lightning protection system for high voltage transmission line in area with high grounding resistance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Most disturbance on High Voltage Transmission Line (HVTL) caused by direct lightning strikes that can hit transmission tower or earth wire and produce back flashover (BFO) on insulators at the tower. Direct lightning strike to the phase wire produce travelling wave that will damage also the insulators and it's called Sheilding Failures (SF). These disturbances take place more often in the tropical area and have high tower grounding resistance. Appropriate lightning protection systems and grounding can minimize the damage caused by the strike. To solve the problem some of innovation technology have already installed and gave a significant result, such as Extended mast terminal <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. Hight voltage 70 kV transmission line in Kupang area at east side of Indonesia suffer of disturbance due to lightning strikes. The existing protection by using additional grounded earth wire isolated by a 20 kV insulators installed at the top of the tower and connected to ground give no improvement to the protection system. With high ground resistance of the existing soil condition the disturbance is getting worse. Analysis on this sytem is carried out and improvement can be taken by using the EMT technology and the use of enhancement grounding cement.

Author Keywords: transmission line arrester and conductive cement

articleTitle: Reactive power optimization of distribution network including photovoltaic power and SVG considering harmonic factors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: In the operation of grid-connected photovoltaic power stations, a large amount of harmonic current is injected into distribution network, which reduces the power quality of distribution network. In the paper, the Static Var Generator (SVG) is added to the outlet of the photovoltaic power station, by using the feedforward control strategy for the voltage, SVG can effectively suppress the harmonic current generated by photovoltaic power plants. When the active power output of the PV power station and reactive power of SVG output change, the harmonic current of the grid with SVG and photovoltaic power will change accordingly. The harmonic current model with SVG and photovoltaic power is established based on BP neural network, which can calculate the harmonic current of both SVG and PV. In allusion to the impacts on the distribution network resulting from the grid harmonic current of SVG and PV and the uncertainty of the reactive power optimization, the harmonic index (Total Harmonic Distortion of Voltage, THD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">U</sub>) is added to the traditional reactive power optimization model based on the established harmonic current model including SVG and photovoltaic power. The chance constrained of the fundamental harmonic voltage and the total harmonic distortion of voltage is analyzed, and the reactive power optimization model of distribution network including the photovoltaic power station and SVG considering harmonic factors is established. In the paper, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is applied to solve the reactive power optimization model and results of IEEE-33 test system case verifies the rationality and feasibility of the model established in the paper. The model can comprehensively reduce the active power loss and the harmonic pollution so as to improve the economy and security of the operation of distribution network.

articleTitle: Investigation of fuse rail in low voltage switchboard burn down in Indonesia distribution system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: In Indonesia distribution system, the power distribution from 20/0.4kV transformer to customer feeder is done using low voltage switchboards. Low voltage switchboard utilized in Indonesia distribution system is consist of several fuse rails, where each fuse rail supplies one customer feeder and the amount of fuse rail that is mounted to low voltage switchboard is depended on the capacity of 20/0.4kV transformer. However, the phenomenon of fuse rail burn down is frequently occurred in some area of Indonesia distribution system and the cause of the phenomenon is not known clearly. The burning phenomenon occurs even though the load current served by fuse rail is below the rating of NH fuse link used in fuse rail. Therefore, this paper will discuss about the investigation of the fuse rail burn down in Indonesia distribution system. Three laboratory tests such as temperature rise test, contact resistance test, and glow wire test are performed to new fuse rail in this paper with the intention of determining the cause of fuse rail burn down. Several scenarios in the three laboratory tests are also performed to represent the operation condition of fuse rail in Indonesia distribution system. All of scenario tests are performed in order to know the characteristic of the material used in fuse rail and also to determine the cause of fuse rail burn down in Indonesia power system. This paper will also give recommendations so the fuse rail burn down phenomenon does not occur again in other low voltage switchboards in Indonesia distribution system.

articleTitle: Planning of transformer placement using reliability in PLN Transmisi Jawa Bagian Barat
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Nowadays, the population of installed transformer in PT PLN (Persero) Transmisi Jawa Bagian Barat is 305 units which consists of many variations of manufacturers and types. It consists of 21 manufacturers and 38 types along with different operational age from the young age transformers (under 20 years) until the old age transformers (more than 20 years). It means, TJBB needs different strategy for each transformer. For the old transformers, the strategies are whether relocating the transformer to another location and replacing it with new transformer or improving maintenance activities of the transformer to increase their reliability. While with the young transformer, TJBB has to plan the quantities of the spare will be needed. However, due to many variations of transformer manufacturers and types, it will be difficult when determining the number of spare and the type of maintenance. Meanwhile, the addition of the new transformer from the addition project or replacement project will be taking a role on the addition of the variations of manufacturers and types. Therefore, the information of the transformer performance is required. That information can be used to help the utilities to know the service performance of those various manufacturers, provide important inputs for utilities when specifying and buying transformer and also organize maintenance for transformer. In this paper, one of the information that stated above can be obtained by analyzing the failure that occurred on the transformer for the past few years. From the failure data, we will calculated the value of transformer reliability per manufacturer. The transformer reliability describes the probability of the existing population to survive beyond a certain age. This paper will discuss about the statistics of transformer failure that classified based on the voltage level, the cause of transformer failure and more focused on the current reliability level of transformer population which modeled by using weibull analysis into transformer reliability curve. In the reliability calculation, the failure data from each manufacturer will be grouped into a big group of manufacturer based on the similarity of the history of ownership and the technology used to manufacture the transformer. This paper have a purpose to determine transformer placement in PT PLN (Persero) Transmisi Jawa Bagian Barat by comparing the reliability with the type of location and customer that will be supplied.

articleTitle: Renewable energy penetration in belitung power system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Belitung island will be developed as one of tourism economic zone. Regarding to this situation, the electricity will increase the capability of supply by using non fossil fuel power generation. Integration of intermittent renewable energy such as photovoltaic farm become a main concern in this development. This paper deal with a mechanism to calculate a maximum penetration of PV farm in the Belitung system without deterioration of existing defense scheme in the system. The calculation includes the transient effect the cloud movement toward photovoltaic farm. Beside the calculation of PV power plant, there is also the simulation of biogas penetration in Belitung Power System. Biogas power plant capacity that available in Belitung is 9.5 MW. The mitigation to make the frequency deviation smoother is also described.

articleTitle: The implementation of probabilistic reliability assessment in order to get mapping of load point index in Java Bali 500 kV substation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: The good operation of Java Bali System aims to achieve a reliable, efficient and economical Operating System. Reliability is generally examined in two criteria: availability of supply (adequacy) and securities (quality of voltage, frequency, and dynamic stability). Currently, there are many reliability parameter applied in Java Bali System such as bulk system, generation, and transmission. All these parameters can be reprocessed by representing a combination of reliability index values between generator, transmission and load with probabilistic approach. In this project, the writer aims to get load point reliability index in 500 kV substation and will be able to be used as dashboard and Management support in making strategic decisions.

articleTitle: Generator shedding for maintaining power system stability in Cibatu34-Mandirancan subsystem
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Cibatu34-Mandirancan is one of the most important subsystem in Jawa Bali system. Peak Load of this subsystem is about 1.700 MW, several industrial costumers are also located here. On 13th March 2014 disturbance occured on Indramayu-Kosambibaru. This disturbance was followed by tripping of two transmission lines and all generators in Indramayu Power Plant. Disturbance Fault Recorder (DFR) data showed that trip of the generators were caused by unstable power swing after loss of Indramayu-Kosambibaru lines 1 and 2. Transient stablilty study is conducted to find some scenarios that may severe system stability after transmission line contingencies. Two methods are proposed to maintain system stability which are reduction of generator output into certain load and rejection of one or two generators. Both methods successfully maintain system stability after transmission contingencies. However the first method is eventually less economical, because it will increase the system producton cost. Second scenario is the best solution for solving transient instability in Cibatu34-Mandirancan subsystem. The shedding time also give impact to stability therefore this study also conducted to find maximum shedding time of generator.

articleTitle: Analysis of power angle difference for defining and reducing oscillation on interconnected system: A study on 150 kV South Sulawesi grid
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: This paper presents novel of power system stabilizer in which intend to investigate and observe the oscillation due to disturbances then define power angle difference on South Sulawesi grid. The symmetrical three phase fault and single phase fault to ground have been implemented and results show that the 150 kV of South Sulawesi grid tend to reach the limit of transient stability and then subject to be out of synchronization. This problems needs to be undertaken by using Flexible AC Transmission Systems (FACTS) to ensure transient stability of the system. The FACTS may works well for reducing oscillation to enhance transient stability phenomena of 150 kV South Sulawesi grid.

articleTitle: Data management in PLN TJBB : Initial business case
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: In asset management, the availability of appropriate information is key in generating strategic, tactical and operational business decisions. Especially in the planning of asset management, it is required centralization and integration of data to ensure the control of the output (information) in the decision-making. PLN TJBB currently develop data management consist of assets data and asset management data. Their life cycle begins from acquire, storage, update, utilize, access, archive and disposal of data. Data management aims to standardize the management of data collection for all department in organizations. Nowadays, the data are still handling with different standard and management. Control data management is important to ensure that data which is being managed are the correct and useful one, and these are being used as the basis for decision making. It is means that we are not collect data without knowing the value obtained from the data store. Approach to data management development are by assess data in order to determine the current conditions and improve data management to fulfill the needs in the future with consideration of overall business process. It is also considering the organizational behavior include: employee discipline, competence level in utilizing the tools of data collection, commitments to the existing data, and so on. This paper will discuss phase in data management, consideration that being used, the obstacles, the process of formulation, unique organizational behavior and available resources.

articleTitle: The ground potential profile on the Earth surface of 3 vertical rods of grounding systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Electrical safety in power distribution systems has been researched for many years. However the respond of human body to the electrical shock not understood well and need to research more. One cause of this safety is ground potential profile of the grounding systems, and this is depend on grounding configuration and resistivity of soil that grounding rod was lied. Touch voltage and step voltage contour can be predicted before to make the grounding installation, so the safety can also be predicted. In this paper will explain the result of experiment in the laboratory with simulation of parallel 3 rods grounding systems that is injected with variable frequency 0-200 KHz. The measuring systems using oscilloscope high frequency for detecting the voltage drop and phase angle if injected by 0.1 Ampere AC current. The voltage sensor is located at many depths under the ground surface than the result calculated with La Place formula for getting the gradient of electric field in the soil and profile of potential at many place in and on the ground surface. The results of this experiment are grounding impedance as a function of frequency, ground potential profile, electric field profile and contour of potential.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of withstand test power transformer based on through fault current disturbance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Transformers damage happened in Transmisi Jawa Bagian Tengah from 2008 until 2015 as much as 54 times. Active part damage, especially in winding, are the most major cases happened as much as 34 from 54 damage (63%), it was almost caused by Through Fault Current in seconday side of transformer (feeder). Diagnosis concept applied in PLN Transmisi Jawa Bagian Tengah considered into three (3) level assessment, there are health assessment, risk assesment (component level) and risk assessment (corporate level). The scope of this paper only discuss health assessment with condition index in each measurement for 21 unit step down power transformers which have been passed over withstand capability calculation. Measurement result grouped into condition index to see what is the dominant effect from through fault current and to correlate the relationship between one measurement with anothers. In conclusion, from all of type measurement were done, the worst effected by through fault current which produces high current in

articleTitle: The design of alternative electric energy utilizes solar heat in the vehicle cabin with thermoelectric module
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: A vehicle parked in the open will experience an increase in temperature in the cabin that can rise quickly in blistering conditions. As a result, the temperature in the cabin will have a temperature difference with outside temperature up to 30 degrees Celsius, thus causing uncomfortable conditions for the driver or passenger if entered the cabin. By utilizing thermoelectric modules that work with peltier principle where if there is a temperature difference it will arise electrical voltage, obtained a system that can generate energy sources by utilizing heat in the cabin. A study conducted by making a simulation and making a prototype model obtained that a thermoelectric module capable of generating power of 0.14W and by placing the module in the right position will be able to help lower the temperature of the vehicle cabin to help maintain comfort in the cabin.

articleTitle: Investigation of water tree characteristic in XLPE nanocomposites for medium voltage cable application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Cross linked polyethylene (XLPE) is a polymeric material that has been used as insulator and it is widely used for underground cable nowadays. The underground cable may contain defects such as void and impurities due to imperfect manufacturing processes, and exposed to the moisture, which eventually could initiate to the occurrence of water tree under high voltage application. The occurrence of water tree in the cable could lead to the breakdown of the power cable. By addition of nanofiller, the process of water tree formation could be slow down. In this work, an experiment has been carried out to investigate the water tree properties in XLPE nanocomposite for medium voltage cable application. Experiment is performed to observe the real formation of the water tree under high voltage application and to gain better understanding on how the nanofiller could slow down the formation of the water tree. Two types of nanofiller such as Zinc Oxide and Alumina are used with different weight percentage which are 0wt%, 0.5wt%, 1wt% and 1.5wt%. As a result, water tree formation can be observed and the time of water trees start to occur for each type of nanofillers are different. The nanofillers of 1wt% Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> in XLPE inhibit the significant growth of water tree compared to other weight percent of both nanofillers.

articleTitle: Statistical analysis for internal and surface discharges identification in XLPE insulation under AC voltages
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: One of the most effective methods to assess the quality of solid insulated cable under AC or DC voltage is partial discharge (PD) analysis. Several common methods to analyze PD phenomenon based on PD data sets, such as PD magnitude, phase, and occurrence time, have been investigated and interpreted. In this paper, a new approach using the statistical parameters obtained from the PD magnitude density function and inter-time density function was used. To carry out this identification process, a technique for measuring PD with high sensitivity under AC voltage was developed, with the aid of TF map algorithm to separate noise from PD. The results show that identification of internal and surface discharges can be performed successfully.

articleTitle: Designing of characteristic test equipment for over current relays with current capacity of 30 amperes
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Relay testing unit that has been widely available in the electricity industry is largely a multifunctional tester, so it tends to be complex and expensive. Then came the idea to design relay testing unit which is simple and economical, especially to test the characteristics of the over current relays with emphasis on precision and accuracy. The final results that are being expected is a simple test equipment that can be used to inject the current up to 30 A and to see the time with a precision of 1/1000 s in an over current relays. So the average results from testing the characteristic is 0,424 s for standard inverse, 0.576 s for very inverse, 1,125 s for extremely inverse and 5,252 s for long time inverse. Which is compared with the avarage results of the characteristics that are obtained from the calculation; 0,439 s for standard inverse, 0,551 s for very inverse, 1,093 s for extremely inverse and 4,9 s for long time inverse. The comparison data of the test results and the calculation result is not much different. So it can be concluded that relay MCGG53 that being use as the test object is still good and proper for use.

articleTitle: Composite reliability analysis of 500 kV Jawa-Bali system related to the Northern Jawa generation and transmission expansion plan
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: In the document of RUPTL 2016–2025, PT.PLN plan to build new power plants with a total capacity of 7,220 MW as part of 35.000 MW project and new transmission lines Tanjung Jati — Cibatu Baru that will be operated in 2019. These projects are located at the northern line of Java Island. Calculation of power system reliability indices is performed at the hierarchy level II which is a combination of generation (power plants) and transmission systems. This study calculates the energy that is not served (EENS) for one year (MWh/year) in 2019. The results showed that the value of composite reliability index EENS was 5,771.39 MWh/year with 0.0045% ratio. A large addition of generation and power flow changing on transmission lines after the construction of new power plants and new transmission lines influenced the reliability of the 500 kV Java-Bali power system. The larger addition of generation on the system, the greater power flow on the transmission lines. The addition of power plants and transmission lines to the system decreased the EENS value, thus it increased the reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Direct impact from the through fault current of 150/20 kV transformer to its dissolved gas analysis test in PT. PLN (Persero) TJBB APP Durikosambi
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: In 2014, PT. PLN (Persero) P3B Jawa Bali has 150/20 kV power transformers as much as 695 transformers. The average lifetime of 150/20 kV transformers is 14.55 years while it was designed for 40 years. The delayed of feeder protection on handling disturbance can cause through fault current of the transformer. Through fault current may result abnormalities. Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA) can be used for knowing the impact of abnormalities on transformers. In the event of abnormalities on transformers, insulation oil as hydrocarbon chains will break down due to the amount of energy and will form hydrocarbon gases dissolved in the insulating oil. The withstand capability of the transformer is related to the current through the transformer and the duration of time. On IEEE Std. C57.109-1993 with no explicit mention that the withstand capability of the transformer is at maximum short circuit current with 2 s duration. By comparing the magnitude and duration of the external fault occurring on the transformer with DGA, the direct impact between the through fault current and the abnormalities of the transformer can be found. It is used to analyze, evaluate and provide appropriate treatment for the transformer. In this paper, the samples were taken from several substations in the scope of APP Durikosambi with a reference to substations that often occur faults. From those substations, the samples are taken from transformers with the high frequency of disturbance. The results show that the through fault current affects the increase of CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> and C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> gases while other gasses randomly change. CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> and C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> gases start appear simultaneously at percentage of through fault current more than 3.58%. According to increased gas, through fault current cause sparking, local overheating and severe overheating on transformer. Furthermore, the duration of through fault current affects dissolved gas.

articleTitle: Study on reactive power optimization of ACDC hybrid distribution network with electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: This paper briefly introduces the charging and discharging characteristics of electric vehicles, and calculates the charging and discharging load of electric vehicles by Monte Carlo simulation method. A dynamic scene analysis method is used to deal with the stochastic uncertainty of electric vehicles charging and discharging, and the dynamic neural network is used to predict the load. The paper uses the Latin hypercube sampling method to sample the predictive error, uses the K-means clustering method to reduce scenes, and finally produces dynamic load scenarios of the same time section. The AC/DC hybrid power distribution system is the research object and the reactive power optimization model is established with the lowest operating cost of the whole system as objective function. The second-order cone relaxation is applied to AC distribution network power flow constraints, DC distribution network power flow constraints and voltage source converter operation controlling constraints. The paper analyzes the reactive power optimization and control of the system with electric vehicles by Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm, obtains the compensation scheme of multi scenes reactive power optimization at the same time section, and a robust optimization scheme is proposed to guide the optimization of reactive power compensation in the system. This scheme is applicable to other scenarios through model testing, and the validity of the algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Analysis and comparison of emission reduction effect of real-time electricity price considering carbon trading permits
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Real-time demand response pricing mechanism can guide electricity consumption habits through price signals, thereby saving costs and improving the quality of the electricity curve. In this paper, the carbon emission permits trade mechanism is introduced into real-time electricity price (RTP) mechanism. Under the basic principle of carbon trading and the traditional unit commitment model, an economic dispatch model containing wind power under the RTP taking the carbon permits cost into account is established, combined with the response of the consumers to the electricity price. Case study illustrates the effect of the price mechanism on the wind power consumption and the efficiency of emission reduction. It is also compared the impacts of different demand response pricing mechanisms on scheduling results and emission reduction benefits. The result implies that RTP with cost of carbon emissions makes the larger environmental benefits and less influence on customer's electricity experience than other price mechanisms.

articleTitle: Health and risk assesment of power transformer in PLN Transmisi Jawa Bagian Barat
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Power transformer has an important role to transfer energy from power plant to consumer. There are 325 banks of power transformer had been installed in PLN TJBB which various ages and manufacturers. In order to manage the assets, PLN TJBB implemented asset management system based on ISO 55001. One of asset management objective is to fulfill transmission service quality level. However, transformer failures will not fulfill the objective. PLN TJBB had developed a model to determine risk of transformer failure. This model combine health and risk assesment of power transformer in PLN TJBB. Health assesment model describing condition of each subsystem of power transformer, while risk assesment considering some external parameters that can affect transformer performance. These external parameters known as risk factors. Risk factors were determined based on environmental condition where the transformer operated, that may accelerate degradation of insulating material and / or mechanical structure. There are four risk factors that are considered, i.e. transformer reliability, age, through fault current (for distribution transformer), average load, and the typical of load. Both health and risk assesment model then combined into a matrix to result in classification of probability of failure of power transformer. The probability of failure will be used to plan further programme in managing power transformer. In this paper, maintenance model will be applied on one of the transformers, and result in probability of failure. A transformer with high probability of failure could be replace, based on the criticalize of the transformer. In this case, further analysis is needed.

articleTitle: Degradation mechanism of power transformer's insulation system in PLN Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Insulation system of power transformers consists of solid insulation and liquid insulation. Insulation system has a function to insulate among active parts or between active parts to ground. Insulation system, especially insulation paper could lose its ability to insulate due to ageing which consist of several mechanism i.e. hydrolysis and pyrolysis. Those two mechanisms can be detected by observing its symptoms. Hydrolysis which led by insulating oil oxidation will shows the changing of insulating oil physical properties. While pyrolysis which led by local overheat will generate combustible gases. Both hydrolysis and pyrolysis will generate CO and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gases and generate 2-Furfural compound. But in hydrolysis mechanism, the generation of 2-Furfural compound will be massive due to general area of insulation paper are involved. Ageing rate of PLN's power transformers will be depends on several parameters i.e. ambient temperature, humidity, loading and preservation system. This paper explains dominant failure mode that happened in PLN's power transformers due to climate, design and operational factors.

articleTitle: Understanding the surface discharge activity with the nanofluid impregnated paper insulating material
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: In the present work, thermal ageing of oil impregnated pressboard material in mineral oil and nanofluid was carried out and fundamental characteristics viz surface discharge inception voltage under high frequency AC voltages and with harmonic voltages with different THDs are studied. It is observed that SDIV increases with increase in supply voltage frequency. Also, on thermal ageing, reduction in SDIV is observed, irrespective of frequency of the AC voltage. Also, increase in harmonic frequency with increase in THDs showed reduction in SDIV. In addition, charge accumulation studies are carried out. It is observed that three layers of OIPs store more charge and dissipates slowly. Also, negative charges get accumulated more than positive charges. PRPD analysis shows that the surface discharge activity on OIPs occurs near to the peak of the AC voltage and with harmonic AC voltages when dv/dt is high.

articleTitle: Investigation for an isolated solar plant failure in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: The isolated electrical system is the one solution for electrical distribution in the archipelago. Any disruption to this system would disserve the public and detriment the utility companies because it can't sell the energy. The problem of an isolated solar plant failure is happened in Indonesia exactly in System A. Currently, there are few references that address the investigation of real cases problem, whereas the operation engineer need the reference to speed up the repairment process of the system. This paper has presented the investigation on System A to find the cause of the problem. The investigation method are through the measurement data from the field and the simulation process in order to obtain the current and voltage waveforms that comply to the measurement data, thus the disturbance that introduce in the simulation will represent the problem that occurs in the actual condition. The results show that the problems in System A are caused by the short circuit on both sides of the inverter transformer. This disturbance causes the two phases voltage and current coincide and the other phase is compensate.

articleTitle: Leakage current and partial discharge characteristics of epoxy resin material of distribution current transformer in salt fog pollutant condition
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Outdoor Distribution Transformer is frequently used for 20 kV Medium Voltage Overhead Line. The main material for the isolator is the epoxy resin mixed with white cement (talk haichen). In outdoor use, resin epoxy material experiences isolation aging due to influences from various environment condition (pollutant and humidity). In this paper, results of partial discharge (PD) measurement testing of the epoxy resin material is presented. The ability of pollutant to absorb humidity very much affect PD maximum content. In wet condition (95% RH), the best white cement filler is 75% of the weight for 4.6 mS and 36 mS/cm conductivity, while for 24 mS/cm conductivity, the best white cement filler composition is 25% of the weight. The results of the epoxy resin material current leakage testing show that the increase in current leakage is very much affected by the environmental condition (humidity and pollutant). In wet condition (95% RH), the dry band phenomenon is seen in the surface leakage current increase fluctuation. The flash over condition frequently happens in 30 kV testing voltage for 36 mS/cm conductivity.

articleTitle: The upshot of hybrid defects in coaxial gas insulated switchgear
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Sulphur hexafluoride (SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>) gas insulated switchgear (GIS) is widely used in electrical power supply system and therefore needs regular preventive maintenance. In this research work, a reliable and effective diagnostic technique was used to detect SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> byproducts caused by partial discharge (PD) occuring as a result of more that one defect, named as a hybrid defect. A 0.2-MPa pressurised coaxial chamber prototype similar to that used in GIS was used to simulate the decomposition of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> when partially discharging at 48 kV. Two hybrid defects, namely a protrusion-floating particle and a void-floating, were used. The corresponding detected byproducts using Fourier transform infrared spectrometer are SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, HF, SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>, SiF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, CO, and C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> for the former, and C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sub> and C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> for the later. It was found that the by-product combination together with the by-product concentration can be correlated to the type of hybrid defect. Results also show that the protrusion-floating particle hybrid can be potentially more harmful than the void-floating hybrid.

articleTitle: Damper winding analysis on synchronous generator 10625 KVA in short circuit condition
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: The value of sub-transient reactance depends on the design of damper winding or amortissuer. All synchronous generators have sub-transient reactants even though it does not have damper winding physically. The damper winding can contribute to reduce the sub-transient current when generator in fault condition. The generator quantitative parameters are used to perform the simulation using MATLAB/Simulink to determine the fault current that will occurs and also to predict the magnitude of current that flows on the damper winding. In this study, the analysis of the generator is performed using Park dq0 system.

articleTitle: Automatization of palm oil mixture heater system for small scale diesel power plant
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Indonesia, being one of the world's biggest producer of palm oil, has the potential to utilize palm oil as a replacement for fossil fuel. However, palm oil possesses a high level of viscosity. A heater system is needed to reduce the viscosity of palm oil as well as switching of fuel channel between diesel oil and mixed oil (palm oil and diesel oil). The purpose of this study is to design an automatic heating system for use on a small-scale diesel power plant. The automatic heating and switching system consist of a heater element, microcontroller, temperature sensor, relay and solenoid valve. This system read the temperature of mixed oil. If the temperature of mixed oil is below the temperature limit that is specified on the microcontroller then the heater will turn on and the solenoid valve will allow the diesel to flow to the engine. On the other hand, if the temperature of mixed oil is above the temperature limit that is specified on the microcontroller then the heater will turn on and the solenoid valve will allow the mixed oil to flow to the engine. The result of this study is this system can maintain a stable mixed oil temperature in the range specified on the program executed by the microcontroller with a low deviation value. The performance analysis of this study hopefully can be a reference for future studies on the usage of automatic mixed oil heater for small-scale diesel power plant.

articleTitle: Reliability improvement analysis on 20 kV distribution system using distributed generation injection based on renewable energy
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Electrical energy obtained from state-owned electricity company is often can not fulfill the electrical energy required by the industry during peak load. Another problem that industry faced is the availability of electrical energy supply is not continuous. Solution to this problem, the industry needs another source of electrical energy so the availability of electrical energy can be achieved. This study presents the analysis of reliability improvement for 20 kV distribution system which connected to state-owned electricity company's Distributed Generation (DG) in Karawang Industrial Region. Analysis of this study is using DG with new and renewable energy sources, solar panel and batteries systems, it is aimed to increase the reliability of each load (industry) and determines the cost to build the DG. The reliability calculation is done by using DigSILENT software both before and after the DG installation. Calculation analysis of solar panel system's components is calculated using Microsoft Excel software. Followed by calculating Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE) as a value indicating the cost required to generate power per kWh so we can determine the selling price per kWh by state-owned electricity company for the Industry in order to fulfill the DG development cost.

articleTitle: Implementation of wireless temperature, humidity, lighting and active power online monitoring using PLC for early stage of miniature energy savings
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: This research would be the early stage in saving and managing energy, especially electrical energy in a miniature. The research has been done in the assembly of components, namely temperature, humidity, lighting and electric active power sensors, where they were equipped by 4–20 mA transmitters. These transmitters entered to the four channel analog module of programmable logic controller (PLC). From the PLC, using a router, the signals were transmitted to the computer in wireless remotely. Thus, besides the parameter quantities could be read in the panel, they also could be read in the computer in an online wireless remotely. Based on the testing results, for the humidity 58–60% in range, the error between the site display and PLC in the computer was only 0.3–0.4%, and for the temperature 28–30°C, the error between the site display and PLC in the computer was only 0.2–0.3°C. The error of active power depended on the power itself. For example, the rating load of 25 and 100 watts, the remote display were 23 and 96 watts respectively. While, the time for signal transmission was under 0.1 second.

articleTitle: Analysis on the implementation of energy management and conservation: Case study: Pemaron gas power plant
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Energy conservation especially in thermal power plant has been used energy management concepts developed by experts. Some experts develop energy management models that focus on standardized elements such as boiler efficiency, generation heat rate, turbine heat rate, specific fuel consumption and auxiliary power consumption. Other experts develop energy management models based on energy audits. In this study both approaches are used to evaluate the energy conservation process. Results of both approaches are compared to get the most appropriate approach will be possible to be implemented in Indonesia. In the case study that conducted at Pemaron Gas Power Plant in Bali, the standard approach is only done on auxiliary power consumption and SFC, the approach succeeded in reducing power plant auxiliary power consumption from 1.24 GWh to 0.56 GWh in 4 years. Power plant SFC successfully derived from 0.427 l/kWh to 0.411 l/kWh in 4 years. While the energy audit approach hard to be implemented because the power plant is standby. Application of the standard approach with a focus on the 5 elements can reduce the cost of energy management with good results makes it more attractive to be applied. The result of this study could be used by similar power plant model to be more efficient especially in auxiliary power consumption.

articleTitle: Requirement framework of smart grid software architecture
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Smart grid software integrates various software components in Generation, Transmission, Distribution, Smart Metering and Cloud systems. The smart grid architecture is evolving with new features and to accommodate legacy software elements. Smart grid integrated software is an evolving approach in line with modern Information and Communication technology. In this paper, the authors propose a software requirement framework for the smart grid architecture with a focus on Embedded Systems. A state of art idea is considered, to extract software development practices in automotive domain for smart grid systems. Multi layered software architecture to implement the proposed requirements, is also analyzed. Complete analysis of sub-systems, devices and their operations are done to derive the framework. Master-Slave software architecture model is considered amongst the various Electronic Control Units (ECUs) present in the smart grid environment. All the smart grid software modules and their data exchange attributes are also evaluated. Interface requirements within the smart grid sub-systems are dealt in details.

articleTitle: Calculation of impact turning gear operation from gas turbines in Gilimanuk Bali
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Today, electrical innovation is the most needed both for own use and for industry. Therefore, researchers create various innovations to improve efficiency. There are so many innovations being developed that the efficiency of the power plant can be improved. One such innovation is the use of turning gear operations in generation to rejuvenate generator turbines and improve efficiency. The purpose of this paper is to identify the effect of thermal efficiency of gas turbine operation for 12 month compared to one month operating of gas turbine. In this paper found that the thermal efficiency of turning gear operation for 12 months is 0.4059% higher than the thermal efficiency of turning gear operation for one month that is 0.0178%.

articleTitle: Transmission asset lifecycle management in PLN TJBB
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: In realizing its asset value and fulfilling the stakeholder requirement, utility such as PLN in Indonesia, have to manage its asset for the whole life cycle: planning, delivery, operation-maintenance, and disposal. In line with Indonesia government 35000 MW project, there will be consequence of increasing number of asset in the network, including asset in transmission system. In case of west java transmission system there will be high number of new substations, new transformers, and new transmission line. In other side, currently we are managing aged asset with various type and design. Failure history shows that the reliability needs to improve. Based on the past, current and future condition above, we consider that there is several aspects need to be managed in planning, delivery, operation-maintenance and disposal. By using asset management approach, the strategies for all lifecycle is defined aligned with the organization and asset management objective. In planning phase, we have to ensure designs of the new asset that will be put into operation in the network are compatible with the operational condition and support its maintainability. In delivery phase, the control and coordination during construction and commissioning work is the most important. While in the operation and maintenance phase, we need to increase the reliability of assets, prevent the failure by improving the maintenance system including the assessment concept of the asset, prepare the contingency planning during failure. The whole lifecycle cost calculation is important to be developed. Combined with the performance and risk, it provides consideration for better disposal decision on asset. However, the basics of all is the improvement the data availability and quality, as well as the human resource competence. This paper will discuss about the experience and challenges face by PLN in managing transmission asset lifecycle, especially in Western Java transmission system and the improvement has been done and also the future improvement has to be done.

articleTitle: Dynamic system monitoring and control of sumatera power system using PMU based on DFR
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Indonesia is a big country which has many isolated power system networks. Sumatera power system is one of the main power system networks in Indonesia that supplies electricity for more than 45 million inhabitants in Sumatera Island. For the transmission topology and load characteristic, there are some dynamic stability problems in Sumatera power system such as voltage and small signal stability. To support the system operators, since the mid of 2014 all transmission lines in the system have been monitored by Digital Fault Recorder (DFR). Furthermore, all DFRs are equipped with synchrophasors facility based on IEEE Std. C37.118 protocol. This paper will tell the assignment of a special team regarding utilization of DFR devices located in the remote substations not only for disturbance data recording but also for dynamic system monitoring and control of Sumatera power system from the control centers. It will explain chronological steps of the team in remotely monitoring DFR devices, solving bottleneck in data traffic, and tuning data parameter in the Master PMU in order to implement dynamic monitoring of Sumatera power system. Furthermore, since the limitation of basic synchrophasors software, the team try to use enhance PMU Data acquisition that support Wide Area Monitoring System (WAMS) based on DFR Data. This paper will describe the experience of the system operators in using the application to control power transfer from southern to the Central Sumatera by monitoring voltage stability phenomena in certain transmission lines. It will also include future plan of the team to synchronize northern and central-southern subsystems while monitoring the small signal stability phenomena between both subsystems. Finally, this paper will tell lesson learned by the team in implementing the action plans.

articleTitle: The study of air pollution and waste generation due to rejuvenation in the Pesanggaran, Bali
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Rejuvenation and updating of a power generation technology is to make it more efficient, more reliable, and more environmentally friendly. Those conditions encourage the rejuvenation of Pesanggaran Bali power plant. Currently the power plant uses a diesel engine which emit a 978,448 ton of CO2 annually. The plan is to replace the diesel engine with gas engine with capacity of200 MW to generate electricity. This research will be focused on analyzing the pollutions produced by the power plant. This research will analyze the pollutions produced by the existing diesel engine generator, calculate the effect of the pollutions, show the pollutions data of the diesel engine generator, and compare the pollutions produced by diesel engine and gas engine. The result of this research can be used as a reference to rejuvenate the existing power plant so it will be more efficient, reliable, and environmentally friendly.

articleTitle: Implementation of risk management in electricity transmission to improve planning accuracy
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Massive electricity infrastructure development in Indonesia under the 35 GW program makes TJBB as a part of PT PLN (Persero) not only carry out the operation and maintenance of existing assets but also undertake the construction of new assets as well as the development of existing assets. However, it is difficult to perform those roles with several problems i.e. old and very old primary equipment and problems with existing design, furthermore the amount of proposed work program (bottom up) both corrective and preventive is vast while Operational budget cannot accommodate all work program proposals. The approach used in determining the priority level of work is determined by calculating the level of risk, and the overall cost of mitigation, ranging from the cost of procurement, delivery, operation and maintenance or known as business case method. Conducting a business cases, need several key factors such as individual competence, availability of data and information and the development of a standard template. At present, there is no adequate data and information regarding the whole life cost to carry out business case on main programs in TJBB such as replacement of IBT and transformer 150/20 kV.

articleTitle: Optimal demand side response considering to the peak price in the peak season
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: The aim of this research is to assist the consumer to control the air conditioning load during the peak season. Demand side response model was applied to manage inside room temperature to keep comfortable for the consumer. A simulation study is illustrated the effect of demand side response model application for air conditioning in residential house in Makassar city. In this research there are three kind of characteristic of building was analyzed. The physical characteristic of building was based on the heat transfer coefficient from floor, wall and ceiling considering to the total area of the room and outside room temperature. The result of this research indicated that this model assist to the consumer to reduce energy cost. Electricity market price in South Sulawesi was chosen for the case study considering to the characteristic of building for residential house. In this case, a peak season assumed was only occurred at 18.00 during half hour.

articleTitle: Justification for circuit breaker refreshment program in PLN trans-JBTB based on technical condition and impact criteria
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Circuit Breaker (CB) reliability is needed to maintain the availability of power transmission system. However, its reliability decreases with time due to ageing process. In order to maintain availability of power system, PLN established a refreshment regulation of high voltage equipment. The refreshment criteria are based on technical, age, and risk consideration. This paper discusses parameters used for technical consideration, as well as failure occurrence and criticality of substation towards the system for risk consideration. The parameters of technical and risk consideration are then applied in a formula to obtain risk criteria which used as priority scale for refreshment program.

articleTitle: Observed preliminary breakdown pulses of intracloud discharges
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Compact intracloud discharge (CID) pulses have strong radio frequency radiation, large amplitude and a short duration of several microseconds. There are two types of CIDs, namely positive and negative CID. CID electric field signatures appear without any detectable initial breakdown process. It is unclear how the CID discharge process is initiated in thunderclouds. In this study we analyzed the initiation process of positive and negative CIDs and compared them with initial electric field pulses in the preliminary breakdown process of normal intracloud (IC) lightning flashes. 28 positive and 103 negative CID electric field records were examined. The waveforms of the CID pulses were compared with the initial electric field pulses from the preliminary breakdown process. We found that the maximum parameter values of the positive CIDs were higher than those of the negative CIDs. Furthermore, the time features of the CID pulses were smaller than those of the initial electric field pulses from the preliminary breakdown of IC lightning.

articleTitle: The effect of the grounding condition of line impedance stabilization network on the measurement validity of conducted emission parameter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Line impedance stabilization network (LISN) is an important tool to provide noiseless power supply in electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) testing. There are several brands of LISN that are recognized in the market. However, the quality of measurement provided by the LISN is not dependent upon the quality of the product, but also its application scheme. This paper investigates the effect of grounding condition of LISN on the validity of measurement of conducted emission parameter. The test method used refers to CISPR 13:2009. The measurement showed that the grounding condition of LISN introduced the difference of the highest quasi-peak value of 1.24 dB in a no-load condition and 2.96 dB when using television as a load.

articleTitle: Derating electromechanical failing load of insulator type U 120 B and type U 120 BP experience in subsystem Bali
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: In order to take advantage of the assets, Insulator U 120 B Normal hereinafter “Insulator A” and Insulator U 120 BP Anti-Fog hereinafter “Insulator B” are planned to use for 150kV Transmission Line but the result of PLN Research Institute for Sample Test was failed only in Electromechanical Failing Load Test. In order to immediately need and emergency case with availability of Insulator A and Insulator B that can be used then one of the solutions is to benefit it. Before PLN Trans-JBTB benefits it, this study is calculating the risk to the system. The scope of this study is reviewing the mechanical failing load of Insulator A and Insulator B as consider using in Switchyard 150 kV, 150kV Transmission line Pole Construction in Bali, and 70 kV Transmission line on typical conditions in Indonesia. Simulation is conducted using equation from standard. According to standard requirement for sample test of insulator, Switchyard 150kV and 70 kV Transmission lines have reached the standard of electromechanical failing load but for 150kV Transmission line Pole Construction in Bali has to consider several aspects.

articleTitle: Evolution of thunderstorm electrification before first lightning strike
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Cloud-to-ground lightning flashes are among the most dangerous natural phenomena in the world. To reduce lightning hazards, it is needed to investigate the evolution of thunderstorm electrification before the first lightning strike by electric field measurement. Electric field measurement at ground level is used as a basis for lightning hazard warnings. Also, weather satellites can provide valuable information about the location of convective cells that can potentially become thunderstorms. In this study, the relationship between electric field changes at ground level and thunderstorms before the first lightning stroke to the ground was investigated. It was found that the first cloud-to-ground lightning flashes were always preceded by an atmospheric electrostatic field change at ground level by several hours.

articleTitle: Conductivity of transformer oil under high-frequency voltage
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Proper treatment of insulating liquid will result in improvment of properties of the whole insulating media of power transformers. High-frequency measurement are usually performed to determine the material property. In this paper, conductivity was investigated on used transformer oil which is affected by 30–150 seconds microwave heating as high-frequency wave. The results showed that the duration 30s until 90s of high-frequency wave exposure would be reduced the value of conductivity from 1,835×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−11</sup> mS/m to 1,60345×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−11</sup> mS/m and 1,69147×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−11</sup> mS/m to 1,4333×10 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−11</sup> mS/m respectively under negatif and under positif d-c voltage.

articleTitle: Greenhouse gas emission analysis of energy efficiency program at Gilimanuk gas power plant, Bali
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: PLTG Gilimanuk is a gas power plant in Bali consisting of 1 unit with total capacity of 133,8 MW. One of the challenge of PLTG is the large greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions that are donated to global warming. The study aimed to analyze the impact of the innovation program in reducing air pollutants to reduce the greenhouse gas effect generated by unit 1, Gilimanuk PLTG. An innovation program that have been developed by PLTG Gilimanuk to increase the efficiency of generation is Change the TTAT calculation Formula. This method able to decrease the need of fuel as main energy of this power plant. With the reduction of the fuel, the green house emission at the gas power plant also decreased by 0,76 %. This study will be about how big the influence of the innovation able to decrease the GHG This research is expected to contribute for more effort in minimizing the environmental impact of the implementation of similar programs.

articleTitle: Determination of optimal power capacity for run of river hydro power plant based on flow duration curve using newton's interpolation method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: This paper determines the optimal power capacity installed for Run of River Hydro Power Plant (RORHPP). This is necessary in order to obtain an effective and efficient RORHPP, because the installed capacity will determine the investment and the energy produced. If the installed power capacity is too high, the investment cost will also be high, but if the installed power capacity is too low then the potential of water energy will be wasted. The main factors affecting the installed capacity of RORHPP are river flow and height of water fall. The river flow may change, while the water level falls steadily. Therefore, river flow is a variable parameter and the water falling level is a fixed parameter. Accurate determination of river flow discharge design is necessary to optimize RORHPP installed capacity. River flow discharge is obtained from hydrological data and catchment area which is then processed into flow duration curve (FDC). Based on the RORHPP design can be obtained the maximum power and energy generated by RORHPP, but this is not fixed at any time. The capacity factor (CF) is the ratio of real potential energy to the maximum energy generated in a year. Therefore, CF must be considered in determining installed power capacity. Furthermore, financial aspects such as NPV, IRR, BCR and BEP are also the considered parameters. Newton's interpolation method was used to determine CF, which is applied in RORHPP design of Lubuk Gadang. Simulation results show that installed capacity has low investment cost and high energy production as expected.

articleTitle: Comparison of fuel consumption efficiency of technology rejuvenation from diesel power into PLTDG in the work unit Pesanggaran PT. Indonesia Power UP BALI
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Diesel Power Plant (PLTD) is one of power plants that commonly impact to the environment as well as it's expensive fuel. Diesel Power Plant is still inefficient because of high operation costs i.e. 89,31% depleted to fuel costs [7]. The combustion process on diesel engine does not produce a perfect combustion thereby require any changes. One of technology changes that more environmentally friendly and efficient is Diesel Gas Power Plant (PLTDG). In the gas mode, the main fuel is fuel gas. A small amount of pilot fuel oil is also injected using the diesel fuel oil injection mechanism, and premix combustion are realized with the pilot fuel oil as the ignition source. The maintenance time interval of PLTDG is longer than PLTD, so the cost is more efficient. The PLTDG installation cost is also lower than PLTD because it doesn't require the big size of fuel tank. The purpose of this research is to prove that PLTDG is better than PLTD in efficiency aspect through calculation and comparison between the impact of fuel consumption of PLTD and PLTDG Pesanggaran. The results are expected to be used as a comparative in order to cover the shortage of diesel power with these advantages of PLTDG.

articleTitle: The role of energy management on reducing emission in Pemaron's gas power plant
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Energy management in Pemaron's Gas Power Plant is applied to perform more efficient achievement when it is operated. One of the indicators for the efficiency is the quantity of the fuel used by the plant, such as Pemaron power plant which use HSD to minimize fuel consumption, so it will reduce the emission and optimizing cost. This study aims to determine the impact of energy management on reducing emissions of air pollutants in Pemaron's Gas Power Plant. The method is to calculate air emission through several programs implemented in Gas Power Plant to reduce air emissions. The analysis is performed considering government regulations and standards, also energy management principles that have been implemented in Pemaron's Gas Power Plant. The result shows that energy management program has been implemented in Pemaron's Gas Power Plant and is in accordance with the principles of energy management and its implementation have a positive impact on efforts to reduce emission.

articleTitle: The effect of the placement of testing equipment on the measurement validity of radiated emission parameter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: There are a number of factors that may affect the validity in measuring radiated emission test parameters in electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) testing. This research observes the effect of the placement of video pattern generator on the validity of measurement results of radiated emission parameter. The radiated emission measurement with the location of video pattern generator inside and outside of anechoic chamber was conducted. A ferrite absorber was also employed for the latter case to keep up with the noisy environment. The test method used refers to the CISPR 13:2009 standard. The measurement results showed that the difference of the highest peak value from two location was 4.175 dB. The use of ferrite absorber increased this difference to 22.558 dB.

articleTitle: POME to biogas — Study of potency of POME in Nangroe Aceh Darusallam (NAD) province
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Mill process from fresh fruit bunches (FFB) to crude palm oil (CPO) discharges some wastes. Oil extraction, washing, and cleaning processes generate liquid waste which called palm oil mill effluent (POME). POME converted to energy by anaerobic digestion process which generates biogas (methane). Anaerobic digestion process consist of four steps which are hydrolysis, acidogenesis, acetogenesis, and methanogenesis. This paper explains contribution of POME in Nangroe Aceh Darusallam to be converted become methane which generates electricity.

articleTitle: A method to generate the reactive power on single-phase photovoltaic inverter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: A method for generating reactive power in photovoltaic (PV) inverters is presented. This method is based on the extraction of active and reactive components present in the output current of a PV-Inverter using a scheme consisted of low pass filter. The extraction results, together with the unity sinusoidal signal obtained from the phase lockup loop is used to generate a reference for current controller. Current controler will inject output current that have a phase-shift relative to the grid voltage reflecting the active and reactive power output content of the PV-inverter. The mathematical explanation and proposed technical realization is presented.

articleTitle: A propose of optimizing power generated by photovoltaic power generation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: In this paper, a concept to optimize power generated by a stand-alone photovoltaic (PV) system is proposed. A modification of algorithm control technique for optimizing of battery charging, overcharge protection and maximum power tracking have implemented. The optimum power generated can be achieved by improving the control technique (bootstrap technique) of P&O maximum power point tracking (MPPT) in a non-isolated synchronous DC-DC buck converter for battery charging. Experimental result shown that with this MPPT control technique, the power generated by system increasing 13% than system without implementation, and the efficiency of synchronous DC-DC buck converter is 80%.

articleTitle: An economic analysis for grid connected residential photovoltaic system in Malaysia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: In this paper, an economic analysis for a grid connected residential photovoltaic system in Malaysia is presented. The Feed in Tariff (FiT) and recently introduce Net Metering Policy (NEM) were described. The payback period and return on investment for the residential scale photovoltaic system were calculated and compared for both policies. For small usage that less than rm250, FiT has a lower payback period of 6 years compared to 9.33 years for NEM. On the other hand, for usage of RM500 or larger, NEM policy has a smaller payback period of 5.33 year in compare to FiT which has higher payback period due to decreasing incentive value over the contract period. Thus, the recently introduced NEM policy will be an attractive scheme for consumers who have high electricity consumption.

articleTitle: Comparison of CF3CHCl2 gas with SF6 gas as an alternative substitute for gas insulated switchgear equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: Sulfur hexafluoride is a gas that used as a medium for insulation on electrical equipment. One use of Sulfur hexafluoride gas in high voltage equipment used on equipment Gas Insulated Switchgear. The use of Sulfur hexafluoride gas in Gas Insulated Switchgear equipment has the potential because of Sulfur hexafluoride gas as an insulating gas that can withstand the breakdown voltage reaches 785 kV. Besides having the advantage as an insulating material in Gas Insulated Switchgear, Sulfur hexafluoride gas is known as one of the gas contributors to the greenhouse effect. Further, according to the Kyoto Protocol, the use of Sulfur hexafluoride gas should be limited and gradually be reduced until alternative gas to Sulfur hexafluoride gas discovered and commercialized broadly. Gas alternatives that have the potential to replace Sulfur hexafluoride gas in Gas Insulated Switchgear equipment are Dichlorotrifluoroethane gas. Gas Dichlorotrifluoroethane has reportedly great potential as an insulating gas because it has higher insulation capability than Sulfur hexafluoride gas, and is part of the gas that is recommended in the Kyoto Protocol. Gas Dichlorotrifluoroethane has doubled electronegativity value greater than Sulfur hexafluoride gas as the principal condition as insulating gas and has a value of Global Warming Potential and Ozone Depleting Potential lower than Sulfur hexafluoride gas.

articleTitle: Methods of operating mechanisms of high voltage circuit breakers — An overview
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on High Voltage Engineering and Power Systems (ICHVEPS)
abstract: This manuscript presents a various configuration of High Voltage Circuit Breaker (HVCB) operating mechanisms. As need of electrical power transmission system increases the use of circuit breakers (CB) also increased with high breaking capacity. With this context, this paper deals about operating mechanism (OM) in HVCB, opening and closing operation with control action. Moreover this review extensively analyses the different types of OM, benefits and its failures. The working mechanism of the motor drive device are also deeply discussed which can fulfil the needs of HVCB stable operations. This OM is reviewed in this article can also work under the smart workings of HVCB to balance the upcoming needs of modern electric power grid.
